reasoning_content:
I'm reviewing the validation results from my testing. The container is running correctly on port 9998, and the health endpoint returns the expected response with all the feature flags properly configured—most features enabled, audio disabled since whisper isn't set up, and the version showing 0.9.0.

The version discrepancy is minor since the guide was written for an older version, but the current 0.9.0 is what's actually running and matches the source code. Both protocol versions work: v1 returns standard Tika JSON with content and method details, while v2 adds the routing information that OpenCloud needs. The extraction is functioning across all supported formats—plain text passthrough, email parsing, DOCX conversion via pandoc, and PDF text extraction all return the correct content.

I've verified the configuration is mounted correctly with the LLM, Collabora, and other settings in place, and the core utilities are installed. The restart policy is set to always. The LLM OCR and audio paths can't be tested without live backends, but that's a deployment requirement rather than an installation problem—the installation itself is complete. OpenCloud's reindexing step wasn't run since it's not deployed, but that's also part of the deployment rather than the core installation.

The version difference between 0.7.0 and 0.9.0 isn't a problem since the guide specifies pulling the latest image, and that's what we did. The core software is installed and operational according to the guide's verification criteria. I'm marking this as a success.
